scenario: the binary is not on PATH

provenance.detail: /nonexistent/opencode is not on PATH (spawn ENOENT). Install it, or name a different agent.

note: The one outcome with no CLI version behind it, because the failure IS that there is no CLI. A spawn that never starts emits an asynchronous 'error' event rather than throwing, so it escaped every catch and took the process down until this was handled.
